info.name: Zeinab Harb - Services 4-6 (Threats, Audit Logs, Reports)
info.description:
Sprint I - Security Incident Detection and Response Management System.
Developer: Zeinab Harb.

Run `python seed.py --reset`, start `python app.py`, then run the folders in order (Authentication first: it stores the tokens).

item.name: 0. Authentication (Zeinab Harb)
Zeinab Harb - Login as Security Administrator

request.description:
**Developer:** Zeinab Harb

**Caller:** no token. **Expected:** HTTP 200.

Successful login. Stores the token in `admin_token`.

item.name: Zeinab Harb - Login as Security Analyst

request.description:
**Developer:** Zeinab Harb

**Caller:** no token. **Expected:** HTTP 200.

Stores `analyst_token`.

item.name: Zeinab Harb - Login as Regular User

request.description:
**Developer:** Zeinab Harb

**Caller:** no token. **Expected:** HTTP 200.

Stores `user_token`.

item.name: Zeinab Harb - Login as Auditor

request.description:
**Developer:** Zeinab Harb

**Caller:** no token. **Expected:** HTTP 200.

Stores `auditor_token`.

item.name: Zeinab Harb - Login FAILED (wrong password) - generates a LOGIN_FAILED log

request.description:
**Developer:** Zeinab Harb

**Caller:** no token. **Expected:** HTTP 401.

Failed authentication. Creates a `LOGIN_FAILED` audit record used later by the activity report.

item.name: 1. Threat Intelligence Service (Zeinab Harb)
Zeinab Harb - Add Threat Indicator - IP Address (High)

request.description:
**Developer:** Zeinab Harb

**Caller:** Security Administrator. **Expected:** HTTP 201.

Adds a malicious IP. The value is validated as IPv4/IPv6. Stores `threat_id`.

body.raw:
{
  "threat_type": "IP Address",
  "threat_value": "192.0.2.10",
  "description": "Source of repeated RDP brute-force attempts on finance workstations",
  "severity_level": "High",
  "source": "Firewall logs"
}

exec: pm.test('developer is Zeinab Harb', () => pm.expect(body.developer).to.eql('Zeinab Harb'));

item.name: Zeinab Harb - Add Threat Indicator - Domain (Medium)

request.description:
**Developer:** Zeinab Harb

**Caller:** Security Administrator. **Expected:** HTTP 201.

Domain is validated and stored lowercase (update-account-verify.net).

exec: pm.test('developer is Zeinab Harb', () => pm.expect(body.developer).to.eql('Zeinab Harb'));

item.name: Zeinab Harb - Add Threat Indicator - File Hash SHA-256 (Critical)

request.description:
**Developer:** Zeinab Harb

**Caller:** Security Administrator. **Expected:** HTTP 201.

Hash must be hexadecimal MD5 (32), SHA-1 (40), SHA-256 (64) or SHA-512 (128).

}
